changelog.note: Decision of 2026-09-28: option A: default_arm G - utility bills run on the GPT path with the recipe's automatic path, as one call gives the header data and the line items (the G path's header agreement in measurement 015: 98.7 %); an explicit S request still runs

The base pack of the utility bills: the legacy _shared/utility_bill_hu base - 19 shared fields in the legacy schema.json's order with their kinds (customer_id, customer_code, payment_method: text), required fields and validators from the legacy rules.json (required: invoice_number, amount_due; date_order; hu_tax_id optional; currency ^[A-Z]{3}$); date_order is optional because the legacy golden set's partial bills have no due date; not scored: supplier_bank_account, customer_code, customer_id (rules non_scored_fields) and supplier_address (the legacy scorer's ADDRESS_FIELDS); the high-stakes fields are the policy's base set; candidate profile utility (OCR-tolerant Hungarian), call sites select_utility and verify_utility; text_labels for the labelled text fields. It cannot run on its own (it has no prompt); the child packs name it with extends

document: Hungarian residential utility bill (electricity / gas / water / sewage / waste), OCR text of a scanned PDF (Lnn = line number); the issuer is a Hungarian utility or a payment collector, the customer a private person
